Quantum 1.11.0 was certified on 2026-08-16. It pins **nucleus v1.7.0**, **quark v1.4.1** and **orbit v1.5.4**.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.10.1: nucleus goes from v1.6.2 to v1.7.0 (minor), orbit goes from v1.5.3 to v1.5.4 (patch) and quark stays at v1.4.1.
